comparison.finding: Current source already carries session mode, notifications, parallel and budget fields. It tightens parallel minimum to 1, makes budget positive number/null, validates command transport and separates configured from detected session modes. Old config implementation must not replace it.

Current gate/run split covers force, recovery, lifecycle, limits and checkout safety. Old lock.ts overwrites locks and treats malformed data as absent; current gate.ts uses exclusive guard acquisition, ownership tokens and fails closed. Do not transplant the old lock.

Current step-done uses reason with force, validates one-line text, records a handoff deviation and adds Specplane-Force-Reason. Old forceReason API and fixed trailer-order entry are not evidence of missing recording support.

Old gate.test.ts contains subprocess CLI integration scenarios; current gate.test.ts and run.test.ts cover many corresponding behaviors through direct calls. Preserve old scenarios as regression-review input for manual-lifecycle step 3; source overlap does not establish equivalent CLI coverage or passing execution.

Old branch HANDOFF and spec-gaps preserve step 1/2 decisions and attribution absent from the root branch plan handoff. Keep the branch and checkout; do not copy old lifecycle metadata into the current plan or mark pending steps complete.

blockers.finding: The registered checkout .git points to <workspace>/specs-framework git -C <checkout> status --short fails with fatal: gitfile does not point to a valid repository. CLI list still reports local/in_progress with no attention, so that status is not proof of checkout usability.
blockers.next: Repair worktree linkage through Git tooling and inspect dirty/untracked files and worker state before any retirement; no repair performed.

blockers.finding: agent-skills plan-abandon says preserve branch and worktree unless deletion is requested; flows.ts abandonPlan unconditionally drops a registered worktree after committing, optionally pushes default branch, and requires the main checkout on the default branch. Current checkout is a dirty integration branch.
blockers.next: Do not invoke abandon or force from this state. Resolve the preservation mismatch and prepare a safe default-branch context before an explicitly authorized retirement.

recommendation: Retire obsolete pending scope after preservation and CLI issues are resolved; retain old branch/worktree and historical contribution records, carry useful CLI test scenarios into replacement work, and do not merge or cherry-pick whole old commits. This recommendation is not an executed disposition.
human_decisions_needed: Approve the existing seven-plan/23-step decomposition for draft creation (not readiness).
Confirm the intended retirement of the old conductor plan with branch and checkout retained; execution waits for D1/D2 resolution.
